rationale: Prior measured FIFO retention was short (median full eviction44686.5 new actions for already-evicted SIL4 suffixes). Test a larger history of own score-reward experience without increasing the per-rollout auxiliary optimization dose. Longer retention may improve diversity/retention or may dilute useful recent experience; no benefit is assumed.
comparator: runs/level10-sil-level6-continuation, same frozen source, same fresh-buffer resume and unchanged learning settings except replay capacity; compare primary suites at matched action counts. SIL20 has a different source and is not this capacity comparator.
launch_conditions: Finish and audit both currently active declared tranches before launch; preserve every checkpoint and archive terminal logs.
If a stronger audited depth checkpoint supersedes f58, review the new evidence and revise the source/comparison protocol before any launch.
Recheck source hashes, own-buffer reset path, and exact proposed configuration differences.
Run as the sole full learner initially. Check current free/compressed memory, swap trends and process liveness after both old learners exit; do not add a third learner or stop unrelated processes.

memory.excludes: array/queue overhead, emulator workers, model, MLX cache/temporary buffers and other applications
memory.interpretation: Existing swap usage and observed paging require a fresh post-completion check; free percentage alone is not proof of ample usable RAM.

initialization: Restore source model, optimizer and saved learner/SIL RNGs. Curriculum archives, replay and pending suffixes start empty. No validation, old replay, demonstrations or external states are imported.

secondary.when: only for a stronger complete primary depth candidate, as in existing protocol

final.when: only after freezing validation-selected displayed Level10; never for selection

verification: Check run/source/config/worker roles, bounded storage and finite losses, all own-score suffix and restored-source/action accounting. A terminal budget is an assessment, not Level10 success.
